headlines.description: Nick Mullens threw for 262 yards and three touchdowns for the most productive NFL debut since the merger, leading the San Francisco 49ers to a 34-3 victory over the Oakland Raiders in a lopsided Battle of the Bay on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mullens has sterling debut in 49ers 34-3 win over Raiders

headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes passes for 375 yards as Chiefs down Browns 37-21

events.name: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Rookie linebacker Jerome Baker intercepted Sam Darnold and scored the only touchdown on a 25-yard return with 11 minutes left, and a resilient defense helped the Miami Dolphins beat the New York Jets 13-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 4 interceptions help Dolphins beat Darnold and Jets, 13-6

headlines.description: Danielle Hunter had 3 1/2 of Minnesota's franchise-record 10 sacks and a fourth-quarter fumble return for a touchdown, making for a miserable afternoon for Matthew Stafford and the Detroit Lions in a 24-9 victory by the Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings hang 10 sacks on Stafford in 24-9 win vs. Lions

headlines.description: Julio Jones ended his 12-game touchdown drought, Matt Ryan threw for 350 yards and four scores and the Atlanta Falcons flexed their offensive muscles with a 38-14 blowout of the Washington Redskins on Sunday that extended their winning streak to three...
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons flex offensive muscles, blow out Redskins 38-14

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton completed 19 of 25 passes for 247 yards and two touchdowns, Christian McCaffrey racked up 157 yards from scrimmage and scored twice and the Carolina Panthers built an early lead and held on to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 42-28 for their...
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, McCaffrey lead Panthers past Bucs 42-28

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw two touchdown passes, ran for a score and put up an unexpected left-footed punt to help the Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Baltimore Ravens 23-16 Sunday.
Brandon McManus missed a 51-yard field goal as time expired, leaving Demaryius Thomas a winner in his homecoming as the Houston Texans escaped Denver with a 19-17 win over the Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas wins homecoming as Texans escape Denver 19-17

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Philip Rivers made his 200th consecutive start and kept the Los Angeles Chargers surging at the midpoint of the season, surviving a late rally by Seattle's Russell Wilson.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Gordon leads Chargers past Seahawks 25-17

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Michael Thomas caught a late 72-yard touchdown reception and then celebrated with a cellphone in a throwback to another famous New Orleans play, and the streaking Saints handed the Los Angeles Rams their first loss of the season with a 45-35 win on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints hand Rams first loss of the season, 45-35

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 294 yards and a touchdown, and James White ran for two scores to lead the New England Patriots to a 31-17 victory over Aaron Rodgers and the Green Bay Packers on Sunday night.

Marcus Mariota threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score after fumbling on Tennessee's first two possessions, and the Titans spoiled Amari Cooper's Dallas debut with a 28-14 victory over the Cowboys on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota recovers, Titans top Cowboys 28-14 in Cooper's debut
